answer: Pairwise escrow bonding works like a slow rising tide: every new agent must lock collateral that can only be slashed by a random peer, so one operator running a thousand identities must post a thousand independent bonds rather than one shared stake. Attestation reputation climbs toward a summit only after diverse counterparties vouch, making cheap clones worthless; a violet mark on a caught duplicate burns the whole bond cluster, so spam costs real capital per face.
